classification_definitions.unit: Target is local validation/decoding/state/clock or stub feed; incidental setup/read fixture I/O does not qualify.
classification_definitions.integration: Material target assertion traverses actual production file/process/protocol boundary.
classification_definitions.mixed: Distinct independent local-only assertions and actual production boundary assertions coexist.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Actual source/mapping/blocked assertion does not resolve; distinct from runtime UNKNOWN.

roots.rationale: Stale settings and no-key reapplication are tested through a synthetic command sequence and local configured flag. Real lock/hosts setup is incidental; no settings reach a daemon.
Connected identity fast path must avoid the fatal primaryIP stub and Vault stub. Synthetic status/debug responses drive local branching; hosts/lock setup is incidental.
Fresh enrollment ordering is checked with stub key-read/command state. Key file creation occurs but no content, mode, deletion or other file effect supports the sequence assertions.
Missing SSH key in supplied debug JSON is rejected by local settings decoding. Stub commands never reach a daemon; enrollment filesystem setup is incidental.
Synthetic Connecting/LoginFailed status and injected network-unreachable error must fail without calling the fatal keyReader. This is local retry/auth state policy, not a network outage.

Real production writeSetupKey creates a private file; the command stub stats/reads the actual bytes, and Lstat verifies production cleanup after success/failure. Separate local-only blocks assert Vault-reference selection, argument secrecy/flags, sanitized injected error and in-memory key clearing.
boundary_trace: writeSetupKey: syscall.Open(O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW,0600), Write/Sync/Close -> test os.Stat/os.ReadFile at138:145; deferred removeSetupKey -> Lstat absence at164:166. Stub subprocess and Vault remain unqualified.
Independent unit blocks113:118,124:136,158:163,167:169 retain local semantics.

roots.rationale: Invalid/unknown synthetic status must produce a sanitized error before key retrieval. Error assertions target parsing/validation, with only incidental hosts/lock I/O.

The delayed real Unix listener creates a socket inode. Production socketReady Lstats that inode before any command stub; the stub independently verifies actual socket existence. A separate local-only final block requires two synthetic connection-refused errors to be retried.
boundary_trace: net.Listen(unix,e.socketPath) at319 -> enroller.awaitDaemon -> socketReady os.Lstat at261:262 -> command stub os.Lstat at339:341. No socket connection or protocol exchange is attempted.
Independent unit-only synthetic retry counter345:348 and assertion355:357.

roots.rationale: Table maps injected primary IP to stable hostname arguments collected by a stub command. No live metadata/registration is called; setup-key filesystem work is incidental to the selected string.
Synthetic NeedsLogin/connected statuses and command record assert no redundant down. File operations occur but are not read back by this target; no daemon is invoked.
Observe is driven by an always-Connecting stub; local clock duration/query-count assertions test exponential timer policy. testEnroller file setup is never consumed by observe.
Injected primaryIP error must stop before key/command mutation. Fatal keyReader and unexpected command guard are local error-path observations; no metadata I/O is reached.
Stale debug config plus injected primaryIP error must fail before down/up. Only stub command guards and error are asserted; no live metadata or daemon.

Reads pinned image metadata and version-selected static debug fixture, then stubs command output to test settingsApplied schema/predicate. File reads supply test data and are incidental to local predicate acceptance.

Production primaryPrivateIP constructs authenticated IMDS GET and uses a real http.Client over loopback TCP into httptest.NewServer. Each positive/negative response is transmitted before asserted parse/status/size outcome; no independent direct parser block.
boundary_trace: httptest.NewServer618:625 -> real Dialer626:628 -> production client.Do atpeername.go70 -> handler path/header check619:621 and response622:623 -> primary/error checks630:638. Redirect/proxy policy of readPrimaryPrivateIP and live OCI IMDS are outside this root.

roots.rationale: Saved identity uses no setup-key argument and issues up without down in a synthetic command feed. Test target has no file readback; no saved daemon identity is exercised.

Production runCommand starts actual /usr/bin/env with fixed environment; returned subprocess stdout is checked for absence of NB_/WT_ overrides. The process output materially supports the asserted behavior.
boundary_trace: runCommand -> exec.CommandContext -> command.Env fixed list -> command.Run at exec.go23 -> actual stdout returned27 -> bytes.Contains assertion300:302. Does not run NetBird.

roots.rationale: Production updateHosts reads and atomically replaces an actual temp hosts file; stat checks preserved mode. Actual symlink path must be refused and target bytes are read back to ensure no alternate IP was installed.
boundary_trace: readHosts NOFOLLOW -> CreateTemp/Chmod/Chown/Write/Sync -> re-read/SameFile -> Rename/parent.Sync atfilesystem.go129:177 -> Stat46:49. Symlink update54:56 -> target ReadFile57:60.

roots.rationale: hostsContent directly transforms byte slices; preservation/idempotence/removal/conflict assertions exercise local string parsing only. No filesystem helper is called.

Production lockRuntime acquires a real nonblocking flock and second acquire must fail. Real setup-key symlink is refused by removal and exclusive write, and target existence is checked after attempts.
boundary_trace: lockRuntime syscall.Open/Flock atfilesystem.go27:39 -> second lock rejection70:73. os.Symlink78 -> removeSetupKey Lstat44:51 and writeSetupKey O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW59:64 -> errors81:86 -> target Stat87:89. Assertion checks target existence only, not unchanged bytes.

qualification_limits: Source-only candidate; runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION. No Go/build/test/helper/scanner/parser/framework/formatter/linter/probe/lock/cloud/signing/crypto/TerraBase execution or downloads performed.
No source, repository, ledger, deployment, production credential or cloud mutation. Report files in fresh /tmp only.
Stub commands and keyReader do not qualify NetBird daemon/manager/Vault enrollment, network outage, or registration. File and socket evidence is limited to exact observed effects.
HTTP server uses actual TCP and production primaryPrivateIP; readPrimaryPrivateIP transport restrictions and live OCI IMDS are not exercised.
Subprocess root uses /usr/bin/env, not NetBird CLI; no runtime success or environment portability inferred.
No test, assertion, helper, safety obligation or original root is retired, deleted or granted qualification/count/completion credit. Independent peer and authorized ledger process remain separate.
